summary: Verify current deployed backend against accepted runtime and public inference/session probes
details: User requested deployment and live verification. Uploaded accepted source a239e22 to a dedicated Vultr release directory and built its vision image. Existing model/worker passed verified public HTTPS/WSS generated JPEG inference and session lifecycle probes. Separate session probe passed readiness while enrolled, acknowledgment, duplicate/expired credential rejection and peer disconnect/reconnect replay rejection.
